expose a privileged process handle to an unprivileged process, leading to local privilege escalation

missing_conditions: Verification of same-host co-location of Oculus Browser and Oculus Desktop

response.reason: The source vulnerability (CVE-2019-3562) allows a remote web page to inject HTML into the Oculus Browser UI to spoof UI and 'potentially execute code'. The target vulnerability (CVE-2021-24038) requires an attacker to already have an 'unprivileged process' on the local host to interact with handles exposed by OVRServiceLauncher.exe. The causal bridge between browser injection and a local unprivileged process is conditional because source code execution is only modal ('potentially') and same-host deployment on Windows cannot be inferred from the data. Consequently, this edge cannot enter a strict graph without confirming co-location and actual process execution.
